text: dsh-skill-manager 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 Skill 管理插件，在设置页提供 Skills 区块，并由 host 端 Remote 服务读写用户级 Skill 文件。它可列出 Skill 名称、描述和启用状态，展开查看或编辑 SKILL.md，创建、删除和重命名 Skill，也能切换是否允许模型调用；切换状态会修改 frontmatter 标记。适合需要在 Web 设置中维护个人 Skill 目录的 DSH 用户。它通过 DSH profile 定位 $DSH_HOME/skills，无需额外 API Key 或外部服务。

dsh-skill-manager adds a Skills section to DSH Web settings. It lists user Skills and lets users view or edit SKILL.md, toggle model invocation, and create, rename, or delete Skills. It reads the active profile’s $DSH_HOME/skills directory; no API key or external service is needed.
我想在 DSH 网页设置里查看和管理所有个人 Skill。
怎么在不用改文件的情况下启用或停用某个 Skill？
想直接从设置页面查看 Skill 的 SKILL.md 内容。
让 DSH 支持在网页界面新增一条个人 Skill。
我需要编辑 Skill 指令并顺便修改它的名字。
DSH 里不再需要的 Skill 怎么删除？
I want to manage my personal Skills from the DSH web settings.
How can I disable a Skill so it is excluded from model invocation?
dsh-skill-manager 的功能「浏览个人 Skill」：在 Web 设置的 Skills 区块列出用户级 Skill 名称、描述和启用状态。列表从 DSH 的 skills 目录读取 SKILL.md。
dsh-skill-manager 的功能「启停模型调用」：在 Skill 行切换启用状态。服务通过增删 SKILL.md frontmatter 中的 disable-model-invocation 标记保存结果。
dsh-skill-manager 的功能「维护 Skill 内容」：展开一行可读取完整 SKILL.md，并在内联编辑器修改内容或名称；保存时调用更新与重命名服务。
dsh-skill-manager 的功能「创建与删除 Skill」：设置页面提供新增表单，输入名称和内容创建 SKILL.md；删除操作会移除对应 Skill 目录，并在界面先要求确认。

@wanghailong0419/dsh-skill-manager README · dsh-skill-manager：[English](README.md) | [中文](README_CN.md)

A Skill management plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — manage all user-level Skills from the Web settings: view, enable/disable, edit, add, delete and rename. Disabled Skills are excluded from the model catalog (no longer loaded).

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@wanghailong0419/dsh-skill-manager)
[](LICENSE)

@wanghailong0419/dsh-skill-manager README · Features：- **Skill list**: go to Settings → "Skill Manager", lists all Skills under `$DSH_HOME/skills` (name + description)
- **Click to expand / collapse**: click anywhere on a row to expand details (Skill name + SKILL.md content), click again to collapse (input fields and buttons excluded)
- **Enable / disable**: one toggle per Skill, takes effect immediately, updates state locally without flicker
- **Edit / rename**: inline editing of name and SKILL.md content; renaming syncs the directory name
- **Add / delete**: inline form to create new Skills; delete has a confirmation step
- **Disabled = not loaded**: disabling adds `disable-model-invocation: true` to the SKILL.md frontmatter; DSH's skill-filesystem watcher picks it up and immediately excludes the Skill from the model catalog — no restart needed

@wanghailong0419/dsh-skill-manager README · Architecture：A single-package, two-half DSH bundle:

| Half | Entry | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Host | `lib/index.js` | `skillManager` Remote service: skillList / skillSet / skillGet / skillCreate / skillUpdate / skillDelete / skillRename, edits SKILL.md frontmatter |
| Client | `lib/client.js` | "Skill Manager" section in the settings panel (`dsh.client` bundle) |

@wanghailong0419/dsh-skill-manager README · Installation：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @wanghailong0419/dsh-skill-manager
dsh web   # restart to take effect
```

@wanghailong0419/dsh-skill-manager README · Local development / unpublished：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-skill-manager
dsh web
```

@wanghailong0419/dsh-skill-manager README · Upgrade / Remove：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web update @wanghailong0419/dsh-skill-manager
dsh plugin --profile web remove @wanghailong0419/dsh-skill-manager
```

@wanghailong0419/dsh-skill-manager README · Usage：1. Start `dsh web`, open **Settings → Skill Manager**
2. The list shows each Skill: status dot (green = enabled / gray = disabled), name, description
3. Toggle enable/disable with the switch on the right
4. Click a row to expand details: view Skill name and SKILL.md content, **edit** or **delete**
5. Add: click "Add Skill", fill in the name and content inline

@wanghailong0419/dsh-skill-manager README · Usage：> Disable effect: adds `disable-model-invocation: true` to the SKILL.md frontmatter. DSH's skill-filesystem provider excludes the Skill from the model catalog and loader (watcher auto-refreshes, no restart needed).

@wanghailong0419/dsh-skill-manager README · How It Works：- `skillList`: scans `$DSH_HOME/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`, parses `description` and `disable-model-invocation` from frontmatter
- `skillGet`: reads the full SKILL.md content of a single Skill
- `skillSet`: text-level frontmatter editing (preserves existing fields and formatting such as `name`/`description`/`origin`), adds/removes `disable-model-invocation: true`
- `skillCreate` / `skillUpdate`: creates a new SKILL.md or replaces the full content
- `skillRename`: renames the Skill directory and syncs the `name` field in frontmatter
- `skillDelete`: deletes the entire Skill directory
- Idempotent: repeated toggles never double-modify
